Maria (partnerships): Quick sync — Snow/DBX connector smoke test flagged a ~15% drop in ingest throughput after the new extractor change. Partner POC pinged us. Can eng + platform triage? cc @Snowflake Integrations (partner)
Sam (eng): On it, grabbing logs now. which job/run id should I look at?
Jake (platform): Run id is run_20260303_42 (from nightly harness). Also there was a small batching tweak in the extractor shadow deploy.
Anya (product): Heads up — this blocks the marketplace listing until SLA numbers are back in line. If it's a regression, we need rollback criteria confirmed.
Raj (solutions): I can spin the perf harness on a dedicated pool and run a 10m throughput test. ETA ~30m.
Snowflake Integrations (partner): Thanks for the alert. We observed increased micro-batching that can create backpressure on some cluster configs. If you can try reverting extractor -> v1 that would help us isolate.
Sam (eng): Patching config to revert extractor flag now.
Sam (eng): ```bash
# toggle extractor version on canary
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/flags -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"connector": "snow-dbx", "extractor_version": "v1"}'
```
deploy-bot: canary rollback initiated for service connector-extractor to v1 by @Sam (eng) :gear:
Jake (platform): Canary completed. Quick numbers: throughput +17% vs failing canary, tail p95 latency looks similar. Pushing detailed metrics to the perf dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/perf/run_20260303_42 (internal)
Sam (eng): Logs show backpressure spikes correlated with batch flush intervals. Will attach a short log snippet to the incident.
Anya (product): If rollback holds, we can unblock the marketplace announcement. I'll hold the Friday announce until we confirm the A/B runs.
Raj (solutions): Running 3 more 10m runs across different cluster sizes now, will upload csv to the folder.
Snowflake Integrations (partner): We'll also run a matching harness on our side and share results by EOD. Thanks for the quick rollback.
Maria (partnerships): Great coordination — please paste final perf numbers here once Raj and partner results land. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 9:00am PT to go over root cause and next steps for the public listing.
Jake (platform): Noted. I'll update the rollout runbook with the revert steps and the new alert threshold (batch_wait > 200ms).
Sam (eng): Added a short postmortem skeleton to the incident channel.
Maria (partnerships): Thanks team. Following up in the morning. :thumbsup:
